features.description: Canonical guest bridge (aipla-mcp-bridge.js) with the dual-channel emit (postMessage + window.openai), a dependency-free build/inline script with a drift --check mode, make + aiplatform sim build wrappers, and a vitest that proves the window.openai calls fire — before touching any artefact.
acceptance_criteria: infrastructure/mcp-sandbox/bridge/aipla-mcp-bridge.js exists: conservative-JS transport (__post, rpcRequest/rpcNotify, pending-emit queue, ping responder, envelope parser) + emit(kind,extra) with guarded window.openai branch (setWidgetState + sendFollowUpMessage) AND the postMessage path + __contentText fallback + public AIPLA_BRIDGE = {emit, init, onChatFlush, onHostNotification}
scripts/build-artefact-bridge.mjs supports write mode (stamp @aipla-bridge:start..end region) and --check mode (exit 1 on drift or missing markers on a migrated file)
make sim-build and make sim-build-check targets exist; aiplatform sim build [--check] subcommand shells out to the script

Sandbox vitest green including bridge/__tests__/aipla-mcp-bridge.test.ts: labeled commit -> setWidgetState(structuredContent) + sendFollowUpMessage({prompt:label}); unlabeled -> no follow-up; window.openai absent -> no throw + postMessage path; pending-queue flush on init
aiplatform sim build --check exits non-zero on a deliberately corrupted region (CLI unit test)
features.notes: Canonical bridge infrastructure/mcp-sandbox/bridge/aipla-mcp-bridge.js (dual-channel emit: postMessage + window.openai; follow-up gated on extra.label NOT content so passive settles stay silent; __contentText folded in). scripts/build-artefact-bridge.mjs (write + --check + --root override). make sim-build/sim-build-check + aiplatform sim build [--check]. Tests: 12 sandbox vitest (zero-dep, evals bridge against a fake window) + 5 pytest (real mjs against a temp fixture tree via --root). Sandbox 33/33 vitest + tsc clean; cli ruff check+format clean.
